name: Tab bar
summary: 在应用主要区域之间切换，并持续显示当前选中区域。
behavior: 用于顶层区域，不用于临时操作
切换后保留各区域的导航状态
accessibility: 选中态可被辅助技术识别
do: 让每个 tab 表示一个稳定目的地
用系统图标语义保持熟悉感
dont: 不要放入频繁出现的动作
不要让标签依赖颜色才能理解

en.summary: Switches among an app's primary areas while continuously showing which area is selected.
behavior: Use for top-level areas, not temporary actions
Preserve each area's navigation state after switching
accessibility: Give every item a clear label
Expose the selected state to assistive technology
do: Make each tab a stable destination
dont: Do not place frequent actions in the tab bar
Do not make labels depend on color for meaning
